title: Limit number of suppressed S3 deletion errors

timeline.message: Limit number of suppressed S3 deletion errors
timeline.author: Pooya Salehi

timeline.body:
We've seen this being an issue on 7.x although can happen on all 
versions (I'm pretty sure this PR doesn't cleanly back-port to 7.x though).

Closes https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/123354
